name: MeetingHand
description_en:
MeetingHand supports conference administration from registration and abstract submission through reviewer decisions, programme management and check-in. Websites, communication and virtual-conference tools sit alongside that workflow. It is especially relevant when attendees and academic contributions must be managed together.

Its payment model is a pool of registrations or abstracts rather than a conventional per-user monthly subscription. Free units, purchased nonexpiring packs and automatic pay-as-you-go after exhaustion need to be understood before opening registration. The homepage’s search-position promises are vendor marketing, not verified SEO results.
description_zh:
MeetingHand 支持会议管理，从报名、摘要提交到评审决定、议程及签到，旁边还有网站、沟通和线上工具，适合需要共同管理参与者和学术内容的任务。

费用按报名或摘要额度池，而非通常按用户月费。开放报名前，应理解免费额度、永不过期购买包和耗尽后自动按量收费。首页搜索位置承诺是厂商营销，不是已验证 SEO 结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect abstracts, coordinate reviewers and export programme/proceedings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收集摘要、协调评审并导出议程/文集。

core_features.explanation_en: Purchased plans can be used across multiple events and do not expire.
core_features.explanation_zh: 购买容量可跨活动使用且不过期。

en: Run abstract review and registration for an academic conference.
zh: 为学术会议开展摘要评审及报名。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Clarify unit counting and PAYG authorization, then test one abstract, decision, registration and export.
steps.zh: 澄清单位计数和按量收费，再测试摘要、决定、报名及导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Registration/abstract unit pool, nonexpiring packs and PAYG fallback; domain/streaming extras.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free twenty-five registrations/abstracts; PAYG $4.90/unit. Small 250 paid units/$990; Medium 1,000/$3,490; free units add on. Packs never expire and span events, then automatically fall back to PAYG. Custom domain $199/domain; streaming $39/hour. Currency, dual registration/submission counting and external fees require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费 25 条报名/摘要，按量 $4.90/条。Small 250 付费额度/$990，Medium 1,000/$3,490，免费额度额外加。容量不过期、跨活动，耗尽自动转按量。域名 $199/个，直播 $39/小时。币种、报名/投稿双重计量及外部费需确认。

sources.title: Seamless conference management software for all event types and sizes.
sources.research_notes_en: Conference registration, abstract review, websites, marketing, virtual and QR check-in; search-position claims not adopted.

sources.title: MeetingHand - Enjoy peace of mind.
sources.research_notes_en: Free twenty-five units, PAYG $4.90 per registration/abstract, nonexpiring shared packages, auto PAYG after exhaustion and separate domain/streaming.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Link the submission and registration deliberately
sections.title_zh: 有目的地关联投稿与报名
sections.en: For an illustrative research conference, collect an abstract, assign reviewers, record the decision and place accepted work in the programme. Registration and abstract handling are both metered units in the pricing language; ask whether a person who submits and registers consumes two units. Test revised submissions, reviewer conflicts and a withdrawn presenter. No peer review, programme export or QR scan was executed here.
sections.zh: 例如研究会议，可收集摘要、分配评审、记录决定并把录用内容排入议程。价格文字同时把报名和摘要作为单位，需确认同一人投稿并报名是否消耗两个。应测试修订、评审冲突和报告人撤回。本文未实际评审、导出议程或扫描。

sections.title_en: Budget the pack and its automatic fallback
sections.title_zh: 预算容量包及自动回退
sections.en: Free permits up to twenty-five registrations or abstracts; PAYG is $4.90 per unit. Small advertises 250 units for $990, while Medium advertises 1,000 for $3,490; the dotted thousands formatting in the page should not be read as decimal dollars. The FAQ adds free units to purchased units, giving Small 275 total. Purchased capacity is shared across events and never expires, but once exhausted the account automatically switches to PAYG.
sections.zh: 免费最多 25 条报名或摘要，按量每条 $4.90。Small 展示 250 条/$990，Medium 1,000 条/$3,490；页面千位点号不能读成小数美元。FAQ 明确免费额度额外相加，Small 共 275 条。购买容量可跨活动、不失效，但耗尽自动转按量。

sections.title_en: All features still have explicit paid additions
sections.title_zh: 功能齐全仍有明确付费附加项
sections.en: The page describes all plans/all features and unlimited events/users, but separately charges $199 per custom domain and $39 per streaming hour. Payment-gateway integration does not prove no external processor fee. Larger volumes and nonprofit/startup arrangements require discussion; a climate-event headline does not establish automatic eligibility. Confirm currency, metering, automatic charges and payment terms before funding a pack.
sections.zh: 页面称各套餐全功能、不限活动/用户，但自有域名每个 $199、直播每小时 $39 另列。支付网关集成不证明外部支付商无费用，大量使用及非营利/创业优惠需洽谈，气候活动标题不代表自动符合资格。购买前确认币种、计量、自动收费及付款条件。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the conference path and data exit
sections.title_zh: 核对会议路径及数据退出
sections.en: MeetingHand is worth investigating for a conference with linked registration and submissions, especially if capacity must span irregular events. A basic RSVP may not need the review toolset. Before rollout, test one record through notification, onsite access and export, including a failure. No source license, self-hosted package, retention, backup recovery or confirmed search outcome was established.
sections.zh: 需要关联报名和投稿、且容量跨不定期活动使用的会议可以研究 MeetingHand，基础 RSVP 未必需要评审工具。推广前应测试一条记录贯穿通知、现场访问及导出，并包含失败情况。本次未确认源码许可、自托管、保留、备份恢复或搜索结果。

research_gaps: No submission/review, registration, stream, payment, QR check-in, export or quota exhaustion was tested.
Currency, dual-unit counting, processor fees, larger-volume quote, retention/recovery, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
